response.public_summary: Your parity check is on the right track but misses a small-value edge case.

approach.student_idea_public: Check if `w` is even to decide `YES` or `NO`.

suspect_inputs.why: Smallest even cannot split into two positive evens.

response.root_cause_internal: L6 treats any even w as YES. Need two positive even parts, each >=2, so sum >=4. Thus w=2 is even but impossible and must be NO. Missing `w>2` check causes WA.
response.fix_internal: Change L6 condition from `w%2==0` to `w%2==0 && w>2` (or w>=4). Keep else -> NO. This excludes w=2 while keeping all larger evens as YES.
response.checked_internal: Checked sample w=8 -> YES matches L6. Checked I/O, types, parity logic. No TLE/memory issue. Only uncovered case is smallest even w where two positive evens cannot sum to w.
